datasets.description: Herefordshire Tithe Maps (georectified scans of tithe maps and apportionments)
datasets.notes: 205 parish folders; apportionments in 5+ parishes. Primary: Maps/TitheMapsOriginals (10,354 files).
26,867 image files; large .tiff scans in EN_County_APs (27 GB). ARW Sony RAW files need conversion.

datasets.description: Multi-decadal Hedgerow Surveys (1990–2025) — long-term ecological habitat monitoring
datasets.notes: No dedicated hedgerow survey spreadsheet found. Habitat/ folder contains ecological data, PDFs, JPEG images. Traditional Orchards SHP present. QML style files for hedgerow mapping.

datasets.description: Exchequer Records (E112), 1558–1702 — mediaeval and early modern legal document scans and transcriptions
datasets.notes: E178: 1,116 JPG (3.6 GB); E134: 19 JPG (59 MB); E315: 139 JPG (559 MB). No transcription files found yet.

datasets.description: Woodland Survey 1948 (1948–1949) — detailed survey of species and age class post-WWII
datasets.notes: No unified 1948 dataset. FC1953 (1953 woodland cover, 73 files, 101 MB) is closest. Ancient_Woodlands_England SHP present. 1948 RAF aerial photo and LIDAR DTM found.

datasets.description: Royal Commission Survey (1930–1939) — comprehensive parish-level surveys
datasets.notes: Broad scan of History/ folder. Subfolders include: AALT_Herefordshire, AdrianHarvey, Birmingham archives, Bodleian, British Library, Devereux Paper (Longleat), and 40+ more local history collections. Needs detailed inventory.

datasets.description: River Wye & NRA Archive (1950–2010) — historic maps of bridges, floods, and river management
datasets.notes: NRAarchives: 96 files (966 MB), flood photos Jan 1948, bridge photos. NMRC_RC Wye villages: ~2.7 GB combined. Wye improvement plans. Brockhampton tithe overlays: 1.2 GB.
